messages:
Anya: Heads up — seeing widespread 504s and console errors for sfo2 control plane, started ~10:12 UTC. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/s/sfo2/controlplane -> 5xx spike. Anyone oncall?

deploy-bot: ALERT: controlplane.sfo2.config_sync_lag > 5m (group: controlplane)

Luca (Oncall SRE): I'm on it. Running health checks now. curl https://controlplane.sfo2.internal/healthz -> timeout. getting repeated `auth: token lookup timeout` in logs.

Network Eng: Noted spike in egress to config-store and increased etcd latency. Server-side traces show repeated leader election events ~10:08-10:11 UTC. Looks like controlplane can't reach config-store endpoint in the same AZ (sfo2-a).

Megan (Ops Lead): If control plane is unhealthy we should start traffic shift to na-west2 to protect customers. @Luca can you initiate a gradual shift and enable fallback auth proxy? Keep bursts limited.

Luca (Oncall SRE): Doing staged traffic shift. Command: `redwood routing set --from sfo2 --to na-west2 --pct 20 --reason "controlplane sync lag"` starting now. Will watch error rates and quota.

Anya: Note: several Dedicated GPU provisioning jobs in sfo2 are stuck in Pending with `failed to authenticate` errors — customers reporting allocation failures. Sample sched log: `provisioner: auth fetch failed: 504`

Network Eng: Confirmed partial network partition between controlplane pods and config-store (S3-backed config-service) in sfo2-a. Probable intermittent MTU mismatch on tunnel. Investigating infra-level path.

Luca (Oncall SRE): `kubectl -n controlplane get pods` shows control-sync replicas CrashLoopBackOff on sfo2. Logs excerpt: "panic: configstore: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing". Restarting control-sync pods one-by-one to avoid thundering herd.

ops-bot: Runbook step 3 triggered: scale control-sync to 3x replicas and enable verbose metrics.

Luca (Oncall SRE): Scaled control-sync -> 3 replicas. Rolling restart started. Also opening an emergency NAT gateway on the controlplane subnet to bypass the suspected tunnel.

deploy-bot: ROUTING: staged shift to na-west2 at 20% applied. Metrics will reflect new routing within ~30s.

Megan (Ops Lead): Pause all config rollouts and rollbacks in sfo2, set console to read-only. `redwood console set-mode --region sfo2 --mode read-only`

Anya: After restart, control-sync replicas are reconnecting but config write latency still elevated. We're seeing cold-cache auth hits that spike token validation latency. Console working for some users but lots of slow pages.

Network Eng: Found that a recent border router change introduced an asymmetric route causing packet drops on larger frames — MTU negotiation failing intermittently under burst. Rolling back the change fixed connectivity to config-store in test. Scheduling rollback in sfo2-prod now.

Luca (Oncall SRE): Rollback applied. Control-sync stabilizing, etcd latency falling back to normal. Will keep routing at 20% until full green. Note: KV cache will take ~5-10m to warm — expect transient auth failures.

Anya: GPU provisioning still failing for some Pending jobs that hit auth timeouts earlier — requeueing jobs now helped; seeing successful allocations after ~6m. Sample provisioner log: `allocated node=gpu-1245 zone=sfo2-b`

deploy-bot: ROUTING: increased shift to na-west2 -> 50% as a precaution.

Megan (Ops Lead): Good. Keep an eye on costs — traffic shift and cold-provisioning can spike GPU spend. Estimate: extra burst GPUs and cross-region egress ~+$12k so far (rough). We'll reconcile in postmortem.

Network Eng: sfo2 border router rollback completed at 10:35 UTC. Packet loss to config-store down to 0.2%. Monitoring.

Luca (Oncall SRE): Observability: auth 5xx rate dropped from 4.5% -> 0.8% over last 10m. Console error pages decreasing. Will start gradual rollback of routing once we see 1% sustained errors below threshold.

Anya: Confirming console interactive sessions restored for 90% of users; remaining issues are due to warmed caches. No data loss observed.

ops-bot: Automated incident timestamped and marked: mitigated -> monitoring. Suggested runbook: followup needed.

Megan (Ops Lead): Action items to capture now: 1) add MTU test on controlplane e2e checks, 2) improve config-store retry/backoff and jitter, 3) add automated traffic-shift playbook to reduce manual ops, 4) cost guardrail on emergency cross-region bursts. Assigning owners in the retrospective.

Luca (Oncall SRE): Incident status: mitigated at 10:43 UTC. Keeping monitoring for 1h. Will open incident report and link to logs + timeline.

Anya: Thanks all. Suggest we add an auth-cache cross-region replication experiment to reduce cold-warm penalties during failovers.

Megan (Ops Lead): Agreed. I'll create the postmortem and schedule RCA in the infra weekly. Closing thread unless we see new regressions. :thumbsup:
